name: Capyzen · Gremlet #6
description:
A hot-spring capybara so calm that birds land on it. Nothing ruffles it.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Capyzen in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
